Olivia: Quick sync — I'm onboarding Nebula-XS into staging. Uploaded weights to s3://redwood-models/nebula-xs/v1/weights.tar.gz and pushed a model config to /configs/nebula-xs.json. Staging serving job fails on config validation during startup. Also noticing tokenizer behavior: some prompts that should preserve U+2581 (▁) are getting mapped to <unk> in outputs. Anyone seen the U+2581 -> <unk> mapping before? Need a quick smoke/regression: golden prompts + toolcall structured-output checks. Can someone take this today? :pray:

Samir: @Olivia - can you paste the exact validation error? first guess is vocab/tokenizer mismatch. Also confirm whether the tokenizer artifact (spm) is included in the weights tarball or pointed to separately.

Olivia: error snippet from the staging pod logs: `ConfigValidationError: tokenizer.vocab_size (32000) != model.vocab_size (50257)` — the config I pushed is the one the onboarding tool generated. The tarball contains `tokenizer.model` (sentencepiece) and `vocab.json` from the converter.

Jun: seen this before. Converter sometimes leaves `vocab.json` from the original huggingface export while the sentencepiece model uses a different vocab size. Quick triage: inspect sentencepiece header to confirm vocab size. Run:```bash
python -m redwood.tokenizer.inspect --sp-model s3://redwood-models/nebula-xs/v1/tokenizer.model
```
If it reports 32000, then model/vocab mismatch is real — either overwrite `model.vocab_size` in config or regenerate vocab.json from the SPM.

Samir: also double-check config keys: our validator expects `tokenizer.type` to be `sentencepiece` and `tokenizer.unk_token` present. If the converter left `unk_token` unset, validator can fall back to <unk>. Example snippet we expect:```json
{"tokenizer.type": "sentencepiece", "tokenizer.vocab_size": 32000, "tokenizer.unk_token": "<unk>"}```

Maya: I can run the golden-set smoke tests shortly. Which golden set do you want me to use? The nebula-xs goldset is at gs://redwood-goldsets/nebula-xs/v1/golden_prompts.jsonl — covers structured toolcall examples and a small regression suite. Planning to run: `eval-bot run --goldset nebula-xs:v1 --model-path s3://redwood-models/nebula-xs/v1/ --checks structured-output,toolcall,json-lint`

eval-bot: job queued (job 78921). Will post results to this thread when done.

Olivia: thanks Maya. Also FYI some of our toolcall tests rely on token alignment for `function_name` extraction — if tokenizer inserts <unk> in the middle of tokens, the function parse can break. That explains a couple failing toolcall cases we saw in local dev.

Jun: quick manual check you can run locally to repro the U+2581 issue:```python
from redwood.tokenizer import SentencePieceTokenizer
t = SentencePieceTokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.model')
s = t.encode('▁hello')
print(s)  # expect token ids starting with unk id avoided
```
If you get id 0 for that piece, the SPM may have been trained with a special normalization or a merged unk.

Samir: if validator mismatch is the blocker, toggle the onboarding tool to accept the tokenizer vocab size and rewrite config as a short-term patch: `redwood-onboard --accept-tokenizer-vocab --path /configs/nebula-xs.json` — but prefer regenerating vocab from SPM as Jun suggested.

rc-deploy-bot: preflight check: weights path reachable, checksum ok, image build started (image id rwd/nebula-xs:staging-2026-04-01) — will fail fast on config schema mismatch.

Maya: eval-bot job 78921 finished: quick summary — 45/60 golden prompts passed, 12/60 flagged for structured-output mismatch, 3/60 errored (toolcall parse failure). Uploading full CSV to gs://redwood-evals/nebula-xs/78921/results.csv

Olivia: good signal. Can you drop the top 12 flagged prompts here or paste a few examples? I'll triage the structured-output parser.

Maya: pasted two examples inline (trimmed):
- prompt id 201: expected `{"action":"lookup","args":{...}}` but got `{"action":"<unk>lookup","args":...}`
- prompt id 217: JSON parse failed due to extra trailing token after function call; seems like tokenization boundary issue.

Jun: ok — sounds like two separate root causes: (1) vocab/tokenizer config mismatch (fix by regenerating vocab.json or updating model config), (2) sentencepiece tokenization choices (maybe normalization or bytefallback). For (2) re-run SPM inspect and check `normalization_rule` and `byte_fallback` flags. If SPM was trained with `byte_fallback`, it can emit byte-level unk sequences.

Samir: plan: (A) Olivia regen vocab from SPM and push new tarball, (B) Jun to run SPM inspect & confirm flags, (C) Maya rerun eval after (A/B), (D) if still issues, run a minimal rollout with token-level tracing and enable short-lived fallback to the smaller-compatible model. Anyone object?

Olivia: plan ACK. I'll regenerate vocab and reupload by EOD. Leaving a note in the onboarding PR with the new tarball link when done. Thanks all :heart:
